financial_trajectory.headline: Six-year balance-sheet trajectory (FY2019 through FY2025, with calculated CAGRs from full-year data sourced from the FY2025 Annual Report [E-001]):

lines: Fulton operates approximately 3,400+ employees (LinkedIn corporate-page count of 1,636 employees +7.7% YoY [E-050] reflects only the LinkedIn-affiliated subset; full holdco employment is materially higher per 10-K disclosures). Branch network: 200+ financial centers across five Mid-Atlantic states (PA, NJ, MD, DE, VA), having exited New York in September 2024 to concentrate footprint in core markets. The 2024 Republic First Bank acquisition added 32 branches in the Greater Philadelphia metro, and the pending Q2 2026 Blue Foundry Bancorp close will further extend Northern New Jersey presence [E-001].
Six-year balance-sheet trajectory (FY2019 through FY2025, with calculated CAGRs from full-year data sourced from the FY2025 Annual Report [E-001]):

Trend Classification: ACCELERATING (M&A-driven step in 2024 from $27.6B to $32.1B; +16.3% YoY assets via Republic First; followed by stable 2025 organic growth + Blue Foundry pending Q2 2026). The 2024 step-change from $27.6B to $32.1B in total assets reflects the inorganic addition of Republic First Bank ($6B assets, $4B deposits, 32 branches via FDIC-assisted failed-bank deal completed April 26, 2024). FY2025 was a year of organic stabilization with all three core metrics holding flat-to-slightly-up; the next inorganic inflection arrives with Blue Foundry close in Q2 2026.

The FY2026 OpEx envelope of $800-835M is a material number for engagement planning: it explicitly includes Blue Foundry merger-related costs estimated at approximately $36M, leaving $764-799M of base operating spend in which discretionary technology investments compete. FY2025's $191M of returned capital to shareholders ($150M new buyback authorization Q4 2025 effective through January 2027 plus $0.73 dividend, +5.8% YoY) signals a confident capital posture compatible with strategic technology spend.

Six years of full-year balance-sheet and operating data (FY2019 through FY2025) sourced from the FY2025 Annual Report [E-001], Q3 2025 Investor Presentation [E-002/E-027], and Q1 2026 8-K [E-063]. CAGRs computed over the full six-year window. Trend classifications follow the ACCELERATING / STABLE / DECLINING / VARIABLE schema with directional commentary.

FY2025 record-year milestones. Record annual operating EPS of $2.16 (+16.8% YoY); Record total revenue >$1.4B; Record net income $381.4M (+$102.9M YoY = +37%); Customer deposits grew $449M to $26.6B; Wealth advisor referrals from financial centers +17% YoY (~$50M); Wealth AUM crossed $17B threshold; $191M returned to shareholders ($150M new buyback authorization Q4 2025 effective through Jan 2027).

Trajectory interpretation for Zennify engagement. The seven-metric trajectory shows a bank in active acceleration: ACCELERATING on assets/loans/deposits/EPS/NIM/Wealth AUM, with efficiency ratio DECLINING (favorable). The FY2026 OpEx envelope of $800-835M explicitly includes Blue Foundry merger costs (~$36M), giving the AE clear visibility into discretionary technology spend availability. Wealth AUM CAGR of ~9.2% (the fastest CAGR across the trajectory) signals where the strategic energy is — and Wealth Access's 10K-household life-event detection deployment (E-053) shows where the technology investment is already flowing.

Fulton Financial Corporation (the holding company; NASDAQ: FULT common shares, FULTP Series A Preferred) is a Pennsylvania-domiciled bank holding company. Its operating bank subsidiary, Fulton Bank, National Association, is a national bank chartered under the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency. The institution was founded in 1882 and has operated continuously for 143 years from its current headquarters at One Penn Square, Lancaster, PA 17604 [E-001/E-002/E-003]. It is a component of the S&P SmallCap 600 index. CEO Curtis J. Myers holds an ownership stake of 0.13%; institutional ownership constitutes the majority of the float. The independent registered public accounting firm is KPMG LLP, which signed the FY2025 audit opinion in the combined 2026 Notice/Proxy Statement and 2025 Annual Report [E-005].

Fulton Bank, National Association is a $50.2B in assets regional bank regulated by FDIC, operating since 1882 with 4,500 employees. A 9.2% multi-year growth rate and a trajectory the analyst classifies as accelerating give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-001, E-016]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.2/5. The deepest capability gap is Data Quality Management at 1.8/5 against a 2.7 peer median [E-019, E-006]. Next is Idea Sourcing Channels at 1.9/5 against a 2.6 peer median [E-020, E-002].

Third is Mobile App Experience at 2.0/5 against a 2.8 peer median [E-028]. The issue register adds External customer-sentiment gap: Comparably -21 NPS / 46 CSAT; Birdeye 1.1/5 [E-033]; WalletHub 2.6/5; BBB 1/5; Yelp 3.8/5… (high severity). The issue register adds Overby-Seawell Co. (insurance verification vendor) compromise exposed 100,744 Fulton customer records… (high severity). Leadership is in motion: Prior CDO Jad Abou (Maarouf (2021-2025) departed before Dearwester appointment Feb 2026 — interim governance gap closed by Dearwester arrival) is newly in seat, and new executives set platform direction in their first quarters.

The question for Fulton Bank, National Association is whether to close Data Quality Management first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Fulton Bank, National Association should lead with Salesforce (66/100 fit) against Business Impact Analysis, then sequence Databricks behind it. Closing Data Quality Management to the peer median alone is worth 0.9 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain. Timing favors acting inside the new leadership's first two quarters, before platform commitments lock.
